sloka: त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।त्वामेव भगवन्सर्वे प्रविशन्ति युगक्षये ।। ७.२७.१२ ॥
transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṁ sarvaṁ trailokyaṁ sacarācaram ।tvāmeva bhagavansarve praviśanti yugakṣaye ।। 7.27.12 ॥

translations.english: Indra further states that all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, were created by the Lord, and at the end of an age, all beings ultimately merge back into Him.
translations.hindi: यह सुन कर, ऋषिश्रेष्ठ पवेत से रावण से कहा-यह बड़ा शूर योद्धा है | समरभूमि में इसने कभी पीठ नहीं दिख- लाइ
